name: A_REEL_REVISE
description: Apply a single revise op (swap-clip | regen-art | swap-art) to a prior ComposedPlan (schema_version 'compose-p3') via cosmic-video revise. Writes a NEW plan JSON + regenerates preview MP4. Distinct from A_REEL_COMPOSE (which builds from scratch).

plan_path.description: Absolute path to the prior ComposedPlan JSON (schema_version 'compose-p3')

out.description: Absolute path for the new (revised) ComposedPlan JSON output

op_args.description: Discriminated union (ReviseOp). swap-clip: {op, clip_index, new_card_id, store, corpus_root, transcript_dir}. regen-art: {op, slot}. swap-art: {op, slot, image_path}. Store, corpus_root, and transcript_dir are not required by art-only operations.

plan_path.description: Absolute path to the new ComposedPlan JSON written by revise

preview_path.description: Absent when preview regeneration failed (non-fatal, captured in warnings)

warnings.description: Includes synthetic-connection notices, preview failures, degraded-asset notices

error.description: Present iff status === 'fail'; pipelineError/appError code (e.g. REVISE_CLIP_INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, REVISE_NEW_CARD_NOT_FOUND, USER_ASSET_PATH_MISSING, INVALID_SLOT, REVISE_PLAN_NOT_FOUND, RENDER_PLAN_SCHEMA_MISMATCH)

notes: op_args is a discriminated union keyed on op_args.op. Per-op required fields: swap-clip → clip_index (int), new_card_id, store, corpus_root, transcript_dir. regen-art → slot ('intro'|'outro'). swap-art → slot, image_path. CLI flag mapping is mechanical (see action.ts switch). Exit codes from cosmic-video revise: 0 on pass/warn; 2 on validated expected failure (REVISE_PLAN_NOT_FOUND, RENDER_PLAN_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, REVISE_CLIP_INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, REVISE_NEW_CARD_NOT_FOUND, REVISE_NEW_CARD_NO_EVIDENCE, USER_ASSET_PATH_MISSING, INVALID_SLOT, PROJECT_ROOT_UNRESOLVED); 1 on UNHANDLED (no parseable last-line JSON — A_REEL_REVISE must NOT attempt to parse stdout on exit 1). COSMIC_PROJECT_ROOT (P3 CR-6/CR-8): when set by the parent, the CLI auto-resolves projectRoot and the preview-regen step writes under <projectRoot>/media/reels/; inherited from parent env via Bun.spawn — no Input field required.
